subject.title: Message plugin: support Telegram forum topic management (create/edit/close/reopen)

question: What public Telegram message-tool action shape should OpenClaw support for destructive forum-topic lifecycle operations?
rationale: The remaining work adds public action/config surface and destructive Telegram admin behavior, so automation should not choose naming or deletion semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add explicit topic lifecycle actions
options.body: Add topic-close, topic-reopen, and topic-delete as distinct shared actions mapped to Telegram Bot API lifecycle calls, keeping generic message delete separate.

options.title: Fold deletion into generic delete
options.body: Route delete to message deletion or forum-topic deletion by supplied IDs, but accept the higher compatibility and user-confusion risk from one overloaded action.

options.title: Defer destructive topic operations
options.body: Implement only non-destructive lifecycle actions until maintainers approve delete semantics and proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Add explicit topic lifecycle actions
recommendation.body: Add topic-close, topic-reopen, and topic-delete as distinct shared actions mapped to Telegram Bot API lifecycle calls, keeping generic message delete separate.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged adjacent forum-topic work and already posted maintainer-routing context on this lifecycle tracker.
